line_items.description: Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning wall hung type white vitreous china European water closet with concealed 'P' or 'S' trap, seat & lid (heavy duty) C.P. brass hinges, including C.I. chair, with chair grouting, rubber buffers, C.P. nuts, bolts, etc. including accessories C.I / MS brackets painted with two coats of approved shade over a coat of primer, C.P. Brass screws and wooden cleats.
Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning C.P. brass Ablution health faucet assembly comprising hand held shower with 8 mm dia flexible tube with mounting bracket fixed on wall complete.

Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning of concealed flushing cistern with or without Frame with dual flushing actuator plate, flush stop function noise less float valve and fast filling action with all component parts of high quality complete in all respects. Rates to be included considering chasing in the wall as required and making good the same with appropriate mortar.

Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning white glazed vitreous China wash basin (under / over the counter / Semi recessed) with 32 mm dia C.P brass waste of standard pattern, 32 mm dia C.P cast brass bottle trap and union, 32 mm dia C.P brass pipe to wall and CP wall flange, and rubber acceptors for waste connection, R.S. or C.I. painted brackets bolts, nuts etc. (Cutting, finishing, making holes in Stone/wood shall be in civil / Interior contractor's scope), In case of fixing in stone, will be fixed by civil / Interior contractor.
Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning of Wall / Table mounted C.P. Brass single lever basin mixer/ pillar cock with ss flexible connection and brass nuts complete.
Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning of 15 mm dia C. P. Brass angle valve with C.P. brass flange.
Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning recessed type stainless steel toilet paper holder of approved makes. Including cutting hole in the masonry/R.C.C wall and making good with cement mortar.

Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning of C. P. Brass concealed mixer / Divertor & wall flange (for shower) including necessary fittings/ accessories, exposed part including cutting & making good the wall wherever required.

Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning of revolving type head shower & shower without Frame with dual flushing actuator plate, flush stop function noise less float valve and fast filling action with all component parts of high quality complete in all respects. Rates to be included considering chasing in the wall as required and making good the same with appropriate mortar.
Supply, Fixing, Testing and Commissioning of Spout / bib tap.
